supplied-jpeg-pack.representation: 42 user-supplied AI-generated label recreations and 6 user-supplied composite-image extracts; title/region matching is not exact-ROM authentication.
supplied-jpeg-pack.processing: All 48 JPEGs are bundled byte-for-byte from the supplied all_game_labels_complete/labels folder. The six composite extracts retain historical source references as context; AI recreations may differ in lettering, illustration and small logos.

supplied-png-pack.credit: User-supplied label pack. Per-file provenance distinguishes restorations, original scan sources and labels with no source attribution.
supplied-png-pack.processing: User-supplied label-only PNGs copied byte-for-byte; full-cartridge previews excluded.

game-labels-batch2.representation: 43 user-supplied AI recreations and 15 supplied original labels retained after the image tool rejected recreation.
game-labels-batch2.processing: High-quality JPEG files copied byte-for-byte. AI may alter artwork and small lettering.

game-labels-batch2-final.representation: 58 updated labels (43 AI recreations and 15 retained originals) plus three supplied labels for games previously missing artwork.
game-labels-batch2-final.processing: High-quality JPEG files copied byte-for-byte. AI may alter artwork and small lettering; the three added labels have no supplied region or source URL.
